answer: Work-history escrow with a cliff: rewards accrue in escrow and release only after 6 epochs of independent activity, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. The copper cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the ledger, so a farm that abandons a set of aliases loses everything it put in, while the ivory of forfeited funds pays honest graders and the horizon curve is steepest at the start.
